notes.title: Build 142: Huge Performances Fixes, Grades, Friends Leaderboard
notes.content:
Heyo

In the last patch I introduced huge graphics improvements. But it turned out they lowered peoples FPS way to much. Also people with older GPUs couldn't play the game anymore. So I decided to revert and redo the graphics. So the graphics gets downgraded a bit, but you avg around double the fps now. Also if the game didn't work for you in the last patch, it will work now. 

Update: The game is not working for dx9 users yet, but I working on it, to get it out as fast as possible.

Added grades on the different game modes. You will get a grade (E, D, C, B, A, S), depending on how much score you got. Can you manage to get S on all maps? Grades SS and SSS will be introduced at a later date.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/070490e4e46762169b981b7a28c2b2ae5ba27ac7.png

Added friends leaderboard. Now you can compete against your friends for the number 1 spot on the leaderboard.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/a4e7d14527e814c40716f4153e8702166d11174b.png

You can now override the wall texture, to make it look how you want it to look.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/8f9a05380f0ebc1fc65cde372a33599f5b933249.png

Full Patch Notes
  Fixed the game not working for DX9 users
 Added 3 achievements
 Friends leaderboard
 Added so you can override wall textures
 Graphics changes
 Performance improvements
 Fixed so your leaderboard score updates directly when you finish a level
 Changed Sphere Targets Standard Preset to two targets
 Changed texture on Sphere Targets to match the other spheres


Make sure to visit us on Discord. https://discord.gg/j6qhUUH

notes.title: Aimtastic Build 141: Biggest Update To Date + DLC Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is the largest update for the game so far, doubling the amount of playable game modes from 11 to 22, I won’t go into detail on every mode here, but you can get a brief overview in this trailer. And to celebrate the DLC is on sale now, so get it while it's cheap.

[previewyoutube=MOH5wcWqw6s;full][/previewyoutube]


This update also contains a full graphics rework, and visual customization is in the works, allowing you greater freedom in how your game looks.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/86228560a39267b3f436b4d91497b83716dc274c.png




When selecting a mode, you can now hover your mouse over the game mode in question to see a small preview, the update will also allow you to filter out game modes, allowing you to easily find the one you want.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/bf70f01130e87d5bc85f46ba4d025d82337f87d3.png


The update also adds a new feature that allows you to easily convert your Aimtastic sensitivity to and from different games. You can also set it to cm/360 should you wish to.
Support for Rainbow 6: Siege sensitivity has been added.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31727798/71fac6415794f3811b4842889985be9fa863a8b5.png

FAQ:
Q: Why are you so greedy and want money from us?
A: The money will allow me to work full time on the game, instead of just when I have spare time. So this will mean updates more often.
    All the money goes straight back into the game, to make it as good as possible.

Q: Will I have to pay for things that were free last patch?
A: No, everything that was free before is still free now. I also add new free things from time to time.

Q: I don't like this/I want this.
A: The community involvement is a big part of this game, I try to add in suggestions whenever possible.
    The best way of getting your feedback through is either on Discord or in the Steam Discussions.


Make sure to visit us on Discord. https://discord.gg/j6qhUUH

notes.title: Alpha Build 139: New UI
notes.content:
Most people would probably have wanted something bigger from this patch, but sadly I can't give it to you. I been focusing on getting the UI to a good state, so I can start focusing more on game play related things.


 Completely new UI, more streamlined and easier to use.
 Moddable UI.
 If you know html/css then feel free to edit the UI to however you want it to look like. The files for the UI is located at "GameDir/BrowserAssets"
  

 Rewrote the global leaderboard completely.
 This sadly means all scores got wiped, but is gonna allow better features in the future. Steams leaderboard didn't give me enough control of the leaderboards that I wanted, so had to rewrite to my own system. So I can ban cheaters and get better information out of the leaderboards.
 


 Added 27 new gun sounds.

 The gun sounds was lacking a bit in variety, so added a bunch more.
  
 Added a gun model. (Disable by default, you can enable it in Settings)
  The gun model is very much work in progress, it's missing important stuff like sway, but it's there if you wanna try it out.
 

 Updated Unity Version
 Fixes "All resolution switches have failed Screen" 
 Other resolution based bugs fixed.
 A lot of users had bugs and crashes that have to with the resolution, those should be fixed now.
 
 [Bigger N Smaller] Fixed bug where it didn't set speedup time to right value when changing presets.

 Fixed bug where popup text was rendered behind objects.
 Sound setting now scales linear.
 Before the 0-70% of the volume slider sounded the same, now you should have more control of the volume, so you can get it how you like it.
  
 Movement settings are gone for time being.


Your feedback is always really important for the development of the game. Best way of getting your feedback heard is by joining the games discord.
https://discord.gg/j6qhUUH

notes.title: Build 133: Workshop, Wizards, Presets + a lot more
notes.content:
Workshop
Added workshop support. Currently it only support hit/shot sounds.
But in the future a lot more things will have workshop support.
You can upload to the workshop by downloading "Aimtastic Workshop Tools" under the tools menu on Steam.
I'm looking forward to seeing your content.

Wizards
Added wizards. Wizards are an easy way to convert your settings from different games to Aimtastic.
All you need to do is enter the settings from the game you want to convert from, then it automatically set your FOV and sensitivity and other settings to the correct values.
Currently it only supports Overwatch, Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds. But a lot more games are coming in future updates.

Presets
Added settings presets for room settings. 
Now you can easily save them, so you don't have to re-enter the settings every time you launch the game.

UI
Big UI rework, that is gonna let me make bigger changes much faster.
I rewrote the whole UI, the old way didn't let me make changes as fast as I wanted, and had some performance issues.

Sensitivity
It now saves sensitivity as CSGO/Source/Quake sensitivity instead of Unity. It's gonna automaticly convert your settings, so don't worry about your settings being wrong.
This is more to make it easier for people to convert sensitivity, and make sensitivity bit a less confusing for people.
But what games really needs is a set standard on how mouse sensitivity work, so you don't have to use third-party sites every time you want to transfer your sensitivity to another game.


Patch notes:

[Left To Right] Lowered the penalty for missing to 200, to keep it inline with Reflex.
[Skeet Shooting] Now shows pop-up scores.
[Assault Course] Fixed exploits. Also wiped the scores, since it was mainly full of exploiters.
[Game] Fixed bug where you couldn't shoot if you aimed at the sky.
[Game] Fixed so the game doesn't freak out if you tab out while loading the game.
[Graphics] Improved the floor texture.
[Player] The player has been on a diet. Lowered player collision radius to 0.4m.
[Player] Fixed bug where the player could fall through the floor when going up ramps.
[Audio] Fixed bug where having hit sound off also turned off shot sound. (Thanks Mac McLovin)
[UI] Added a main menu.
[UI] No longer render the crosshair if crosshair length is 0.
[UI] No longer render crosshair dot if size is 0.
[UI] Fixed bug where crosshair preview was visible even when you didn't have settings open.
[UI] It now shows what room you are in when you have room settings open.
[UI] No longer show presets and room settings if the room have no room settings.
[UI] You now see all your friends high scores instead of just top 10.
[Settings] You can now toggle full screen.
[Settings] Added hitmarker options.
[Settings] Added support for loading a static image as a crosshair.
[Settings] Changed max allowed fps to 500.
[Settings] You now hear a preview of the selected hit/shot sound when you change it.
[Settings] Added brightness option.
[Settings] Added temperature option.
[Settings] Added tint option.
[Settings] Added hue shift option.
[Settings] Added saturation option.
[Settings] Added contrast option.


Known issues:
Can't delete presets.
Need to restart game for new subscribed workshop items to load in.
Player sometimes get stuck on ramps.
Twitter feed is missing.
When opening settings, you hear the shot/hit sound.

notes.title: Build 130: Introducing Assault Course
notes.content:
Introducing Assault Course                    
Most of the gamemodes right now, focus on standing still and shooting a target that is in-front of you. But that dosn't really simulate a real game.   
                     
That is what the new gamemode focus on, your goal is to get through the map as fast as possible while shooting all the targets. So a lot of running and shooting, and bigger flicks.    
                    
The current version of it is more of a test, it's gonna get larger changes in the future, and the possible to make your own maps, with workshop support.

                    Patch notes                                            [Settings] Fixed bug where crosshair preview was wrong at the start.                        [Reflex] Fixed bug where second target spawned to early.                        [Leaderboard] Added hits,misses, and hitprocent to the Steam leaderboards.
